None of the official pages consulted explicitly states the publication schedule or the name of the responsible editor; the numbering of the issues (number 13 is sold as an 'especial de 1 ano da Valete', a one-year anniversary special) suggests a near-monthly schedule since the launch, but this is an inference from the numbering, not a statement by the sources. rui.atribuicao: This block brings together only Rui Costa Pimenta, president of the Partido da Causa Operária (PCO) and a candidate for President of the Republic. He has never held executive office or a legislative mandate; for that reason there is, in that trajectory, no period of government to which official statistical series could be linked, and the indicators section of this block is empty. This describes the recorded trajectory, and is neither a merit nor a defect.

marcos.fato: Militants of the Causa Operária faction begin to be expelled from the PT in the states; the group, Trotskyist in origin, had joined the party in 1980.
marcos.obs: The account comes from the party itself, on its institutional history page. No version from the PT about these expulsions was located to set against the account.

fonte.nome: PCO — Uma breve história do PCO

marcos.fato: This is the date of the bylaws of the Partido da Causa Operária, created by the faction expelled from the PT; in that year the party obtains provisional registration.

fonte.nome: Tribunal Superior Eleitoral — página do partido

fonte_2.nome: PCO — Uma breve história do PCO

marcos.fato: The TSE approves the PCO bylaws through Resolução nº 19.981, published on 27/10/1997; the party thereby obtains definitive registration.

fonte.nome: Tribunal Superior Eleitoral — página do partido

marcos.fato: A public campaign asks for signatures and Pix donations to pay for the drug Revumenib for Natália Pimenta, a national officer of the PCO and daughter of Rui Costa Pimenta, with acute leukemia diagnosed in July 2025.
marcos.obs: The family went to court asking for the immediate supply of the medication. The urgent request was denied, with the decision citing the absence of registration of Revumenib with Anvisa — the drug had approval from the American agency FDA. This milestone records facts with a date and a source; any reading of what they say about the person is the reader's, not this site's.

marcos.fato: Natália Pimenta dies at 40, in São Paulo. She was a national leader of the PCO, vice-president of the Instituto Brasil-Palestina and the daughter of Rui Costa Pimenta.

cur.atribuicao: Augusto Cury has never held elected or appointed public office, so there is no administration to attribute to him, nor official series to display. What exists as a recorded record is professional: psychiatrist, author and creator of an educational program sold to schools. These milestones are included here under the same rule as the others — a fact with a date and a source, without adjectives — because the absence of office is not the absence of public life, and an empty tab would suggest that nothing happened.

experiencia_privada.descricao: Company selling social-emotional learning programmes to schools, founded by Augusto Cury and family members in inland São Paulo. In December 2020 Arco Platform, a public company listed on Nasdaq, completed the purchase of 60% of the business for R$ 600 million; the family kept 40%. The company still exists, under Arco's majority control.

fonte.nome: Arco Platform — comunicado oficial de conclusão da aquisição, 02/12/2020

experiencia_privada.descricao: Company opened on 11 July 2002, registered for consultancy, training and lectures — the activity that runs alongside his career as an author and speaker.

fonte.nome: Receita Federal — CNPJ (consulta pública via CNPJ.services)

marcos.fato: Publishes Inteligência Multifocal, a book presenting the theory of the same name about how the mind works and the formation of the 'Eu' ('I').
marcos.obs: The theory is the author's personal creation and has no validation by peer review or use in clinical practice: five psychiatrists interviewed by Folha de S.Paulo refuted it, among them professor Wagner Gattaz, of USP, for whom 'Cury não é pesquisador nem cientista' ('Cury is neither a researcher nor a scientist'). Recording the publication is not endorsing the theory. Catalogs diverge between 1998 and 1999 for the first edition; 1999 is the better-supported year.

fonte.nome: Gazeta do Povo — reportagem sobre a trajetória comercial e a teoria

marcos.fato: Publishes Pais Brilhantes, Professores Fascinantes, with the publisher Sextante — the first of the author's major bestsellers.
Publishes Nunca Desista de Seus Sonhos, with the publisher Sextante.
Publishes the novel O Vendedor de Sonhos, which becomes the author's best-selling work of fiction.

fonte.nome: Página da editora (Planeta/Academia de Inteligência), data de publicação 01/06/2008

marcos.fato: Launches Escola da Inteligência, a teaching-materials program based on the author's own theory, sold to private schools and to municipal public school networks.
marcos.obs: Municipalities such as Cuiabá, Paranaguá, Lagoa Santa and Itajaí contracted the program, with average annual amounts in the region of R$ 1 million.

fonte.nome: Gazeta do Povo — reportagem sobre a trajetória comercial e a teoria

marcos.fato: Publishes Ansiedade: Como Enfrentar o Mal do Século, in which he describes what he calls the 'Síndrome do Pensamento Acelerado' (Accelerated Thought Syndrome).
marcos.obs: The 'Síndrome do Pensamento Acelerado' (Accelerated Thought Syndrome) is a formulation by the author himself and does not appear in the official diagnostic classifications (ICD or DSM).

marcos.fato: Publishes Gestão da Emoção, with Benvirá.

fonte.nome: Currículo Lattes do autor (Gestão da Emoção, 2015, Benvirá)

marcos.fato: Publishes O Homem Mais Inteligente da História, which opens the series analyzing the figure of Jesus Christ from a psychological standpoint.

fonte.nome: Página da editora Sextante, lançamento em 03/10/2016

marcos.fato: The film O Vendedor de Sonhos, an adaptation of the novel, directed by Jayme Monjardim, premieres in cinemas.
Arco Educação buys 60% of the private division of Escola da Inteligência for around R$ 288 million; the program then served 900 schools and 330,000 students.

fonte.nome: Gazeta do Povo — reportagem sobre a trajetória comercial e a teoria

mar.atribuicao: Pablo Marçal has never held elected or appointed public office, so there is no period of government to attribute to him and no official series to show. What exists as a documented career is commercial: personal-development courses, holding companies and property development. These records enter here under the same rule as everyone else's — a fact with a date and a source, with no adjective.

experiencia_privada.organizacao: Group of course, holding and property-development companies
experiencia_privada.descricao: Press investigations drawing on company-registry records point to more than twenty companies linked to him, opened from 2018 onwards, with combined registered capital in the region of R$ 190 million. Among the largest are Aviation Participações (2021), Marçal Holding (2021) and Marçal Incorporadora (2021); the original core is online personal-development courses, such as Plataforma Internacional de Desenvolvimento Humano (2018) and PLX Digital (2019). This site has not checked each company individually at the federal revenue service.

Health, security and schooling, plus the jobs and transport that connect the three.

For those who put the use of land and natural resources at the center of the decision.
For those who think the decisive contest is over how power is exercised and held to account.
For those who read the country through its place in the world — trade, energy and diplomacy.

banner.alt: Diagrama isométrico do fluxo do estudo: os PDFs dos planos entram, são separados por macrotema e conferidos por script, resultando em 20 macrotemas, 8 planos comparados, 836 citações, 836 de 836 conferidas, 10 ausências declaradas e nenhum ranking produzido.

equipes_nota: The people listed come from three sources, and the difference is marked. The ticket is an official registration with the electoral court. The party presidency is likewise an official electoral-court record. The campaign, however, is a role announced publicly and reported in the press — a lower standard of proof, which is why each line's source carries the outlet and the date. Supporters, declared allies and behind-the-scenes figures without an announced role are not included: attributions of that kind cannot be verified. Where no campaign coordination was found, the candidacy simply does not carry that line — candidacies with less press coverage have less public record of structure, and that is not a flaw in the candidacy. Being on this list attributes to no one the acts, offices or court cases of anyone else on it.

bol.obs: Federal representative for Alagoas; was a state prosecutor for more than 20 years and served as rapporteur of the joint congressional inquiry into the INSS. PL.
Advertising professional. The announced role was communications; no announcement of a general campaign coordinator was found.

cai.papel: running mate · national president of the PSD
cai.obs: Holds both roles. Former mayor of São Paulo (2006-2012) and former minister under the Dilma and Temer governments; was São Paulo's Government Secretary until March 2026.
Advertising professional; took over in August 2026, replacing Paulo Vasconcelos. No announcement of a general campaign coordinator was found.

cur.obs: Former federal representative for Minas Gerais, with six terms since 1999; lawyer. Avante.
Advertising professional; took over in August 2026, replacing Leandro Grôppo. Previously worked on Romeu Zema's campaign.

mar.papel: running mate · national president of the PRTB
mar.obs: Holds both roles. Civil name Leonardo Alves de Araújo; coordinated Marçal's 2024 campaign for mayor of São Paulo. The party presidency was the subject of an internal dispute between 2025 and 2026. The running mate's registration exists at the electoral court; the candidacy itself, however, was rejected on 13/09/2026.

rui.papel: presidential candidate · national president of the PCO

rui.obs: Civil name Antonio Carlos Silva; state civil servant, born in Petrópolis (RJ). PCO.

ren.papel: presidential candidate · national president of Missão

ren.obs: Civil name Aroldo Medina; colonel in the Military Police. Ran for governor in 2010 and for state representative in 2014 and 2018, without being elected. Missão.

lul.obs: Sitting Vice-President of the Republic and Minister of Development, Industry, Trade and Services; former governor of São Paulo; physician. PSB.

lul.papel: national president of the PT · general campaign coordinator
lul.obs: Holds both roles. Elected to the party presidency in July 2025.
Left the executive secretariat of the Presidency's communications office in July 2026 to take up the role.

lul.papel: in charge of the campaign's government program

zem.obs: Senator for Ceará, elected in 2018; the NOVO party's only senator. Announced in August 2026, when he withdrew from the race for governor of Ceará.

fotos_tse_credito: Photographs: TSE — DivulgaCandContas, image from the 2026 candidacy registration. Published as the TSE publishes them, with no cropping or retouching.
experiencia_privada_nota: Criterion for this list: private organisations — companies, institutes, foundations and movements — that the person founded, led or holds a stake in, outside elected or government office. Political parties do not appear here, because they have their own block under party affiliations; trade unions and union federations do appear, because they are formal organisations outside the state. The list records what the person is or was in the organisation, not what the organisation did: court cases belong in the proceedings section, with their outcome. Where the only available source is a company-registry aggregator, the line's source says so — these are public federal revenue service records republished by third parties, and this site has not checked them record by record in the official system. The list is not exhaustive, and candidacies with less press coverage leave less documented trace: the absence of a line here means nothing was found in the sources consulted, not that nothing exists.

aviso_uso.p: This site is a work of research and documentary comparison, made on private initiative and with no tie to any candidacy, party, campaign, company or public body. It has no commercial purpose, carries no advertising, does not ask for votes, does not recommend a candidate and produces no ranking.

There is no sign-up, authentication, contact form or any collection of personal data. No audience analytics, tracking, profiling or third-party cookies are used. The choices made in Settings — language, theme, order, colours, portraits, soundtrack — are stored only in the local storage of the device's own browser, and are not transmitted to this site, to whoever maintains it, or to third parties. Clearing the browser's data removes all of it.

The site gathers public-record information about people standing for elected office: candidacy data and photographs from the TSE registration, assets declared to the electoral authorities, offices held, judicial proceedings and organisations the person is involved in. These are data already made public by the bodies themselves, handled here for information and research in the context of an election. Every line carries the source it came from, so it can be checked at origin.

Factual errors, out-of-date data or wrong attributions are corrected as soon as they are identified. Requests for correction or removal can be submitted through the channels of the public repository hosting this site, and will be reviewed immediately. This material may be corrected or updated at any time, without prior notice.

The passages quoted from the manifestos are short, identified reproductions carrying their page of origin, for analysis and comparison; the full documents are in the repository, exactly as they were registered. The photographs of candidates and running mates come from the TSE candidacy registration. The portraits of presidents carry their credit and licence in the footer. Mentions of brands, public bodies and publications are referential and imply no tie, sponsorship or endorsement.

The material is provided as it stands, with no guarantee of availability, accuracy, continuity or fitness for any particular purpose. Official series may be revised by the bodies that publish them, and the status of a candidacy may change by court decision after the last update.
